default_question_applicability_v1.description: Evaluate applicability using the question definition and reviewed evidence; record not_applicable only with a versioned reason.

conditional_by_reviewed_evidence_v1.description: Evaluate whether the concept applies before assigning a coverage state; question-specific scientific rules remain a contract-phase review item.

consumer_contract.resolution_rule: Sparse question overrides inherit the named defaults. Runtime behavior must use the fully resolved contract and may not infer behavior from question-key prefixes.

crystallography.space_group.label: Space group
crystallography.space_group.question: What space group is reported?
crystallography.space_group.scientific_definition: Repeatable source-attributed observations of an explicitly reported ordinary three-dimensional space-group designation. Preserve independently reported Hermann–Mauguin, Hall, International Tables number and coordinate-system context, including contradictions and provenance layers; do not infer symmetry from unit-cell metrics or silently select a universal species setting. Superspace and magnetic groups are outside version 1 and require review.

value_schema.shape: Repeatable space-group observations with H–M/Hall/IT identifiers, setting context, consistency, and provenance

crystallography.unit_cell.label: Unit cell
crystallography.unit_cell.question: What unit-cell parameters and `Z` are reported, under what conditions?
crystallography.unit_cell.scientific_definition: A repeatable complete six-parameter unit cell explicitly reported for one source determination, retaining source precision and uncertainty, any reported volume, Z with formula context, method, radiation, and distinct temperature or pressure conditions. Missing symmetry-constrained parameters are not inferred; separate determinations are never averaged or silently reduced to one species-wide value.

value_schema.shape: Repeatable complete six-parameter cells in angstrom/degree with uncertainty, reported volume, Z/formula context, method, and temperature/pressure conditions

crystallography.structure_references.label: Structure references
crystallography.structure_references.question: Which structural determinations support the profile?
crystallography.structure_references.scientific_definition: Repeatable structured bibliographic citations carried by a reviewed structure record and judged to concern the mapped mineral species. Preserve author order, publication status, identifiers and source citation roles; a generic source-record citation is not upgraded to a primary determination, refinement, or reanalysis without explicit evidence.

value_schema.shape: Repeatable structure-record citations with explicit roles, publication status, ordered authors, DOI or bibliography, and source linkage

source_external_id.description: Source-owned occurrence, locality, specimen, or deposit identifier when available.

locality_type.description: Controlled physical type such as mine, quarry, outcrop, deposit, district, or region.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 only when source resolution supports it.

admin_areas.description: Ordered optional administrative hierarchy with vocabulary and source context.

basis.description: Type locality, collected specimen, observed in place, mine/deposit record, literature report, or historical report.

temporal_status.description: Current, historical, or unknown state, distinct from missingness.

event_date.description: Partial date with stated precision and event kind.

geometry.description: WGS84 point or reviewed area geometry; never silently geocoded from text.

uncertainty_radius_m.description: Nonnegative uncertainty for a point when known.

coordinate_origin.description: Source-supplied, calculated, or geocoded, with method and version where applicable.

publication_transform.description: Unchanged, coarsened, or withheld, with transformation/version and reason.

lifecycle_state.description: Active, superseded, or withdrawn; temporal and evidence-review states remain separate.

geological_context.description: Optional occurrence-specific host rock, deposit type, formation, alteration, and paragenesis.

associated_minerals.description: Optional typed material relations specific to this occurrence.

evidence.description: LOC1 source, exact locator, retrieval/hash/license snapshot, confidence, and review state.

conflict_note.description: Required when source locality or coordinate claims conflict.
